item.title: South Korea Debuts Detect AI Exam Anti-Cheating System Using Radio Signals
item.description:
SKIP, a drone-detection startup incubated by Korea East-West Power, has completed Detect AI, an exam anti-cheating system that cross-references wireless signal vendor identifiers and device unique IDs to flag AI smart glasses, micro cameras and wireless earbuds. The system only passively receives signals without decoding or storing content, and will be demonstrated publicly at COMEUP 2026 in Seoul on December 9.

原文标题：韩国推出 Detect AI 考场反作弊系统 靠无线电波识别智能眼镜

Why it matters：将国防级射频探测技术迁移至考场反 AI 作弊，是 AI 硬件普及催生的新型安防需求样本。

item.title: Stanford Study Finds 72% of Pro Se Lawsuits Show AI Drafting Signs
item.description:
A Stanford study of 127,518 lawsuits across four U.S. state courts estimates that about 72% of complaints filed without lawyers in Santa Clara County now show signs of AI drafting, up from 19% in 2024; lawyer-filed complaints rose from 5% to 34% over the same period. Because legal writing is highly formulaic, individual AI detectors rated anywhere from 10% to 98% of the same complaints as AI-written, so researchers calibrated against filings where judges caught citations to fake cases. The method can only estimate AI use at the court level and cannot prove any single filing used AI.

原文标题：斯坦福研究：圣克拉拉县 72% 无律师诉状含 AI 起草痕迹

Why it matters：首次以十万级诉状样本量化 AI 在法律实务中的渗透速度，并坦诚披露检测方法的局限。

item.title: New York State Bans AI Chat Toys for Five Years with $15,000 Daily Fines
item.description:
New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a bill suspending the manufacture, distribution and sale of internet-connected AI chat toys in the state for five years, with non-compliant makers facing fines of up to $15,000 per day. Officials and advocates cited cases of AI toys producing inappropriate or sexual content and dangerous advice, arguing existing safeguards are minimal. It marks the first state-level sales ban on AI consumer hardware in the US, drawing a hard compliance line for children's AI products.

原文标题：纽约州暂停 AI 聊天玩具销售 5 年 违规日罚 1.5 万美元

Why it matters：美国首个州级 AI 玩具销售禁令落地，直接改变儿童 AI 硬件的合规与市场边界。

item.title: Google DeepMind Launches Mass Spec Agent Boosting Accuracy to 97%
item.description:
Google DeepMind, together with analytical chemists, released Mass Spec Skills, a domain-specific skill set for the Google Antigravity platform that combines Gemini's chemical reasoning with mass spectrometry tools and public chemical database queries. Without tooling, frontier models scored below 4% accuracy; with the skill set, even lightweight models reach 97% retrieval identification accuracy and produce auditable evidence chains.

原文标题：谷歌 DeepMind 推出质谱分析智能体 准确率升至 97%

Why it matters：该工作展示了智能体技能集如何将语言模型的化学推理与专业工具链结合，把质谱解析准确率从不足 4% 提升至 97%，是 AI for Science 领域可复用的工程范式。

item.title: TypeSafe's Jev Likely a Fine-Tune of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
item.description:
TypeSafe's System One model Jev produces calibrated judgments rather than generated text, and its architecture has long been a subject of speculation. Third-party analysis using inference-speed signatures and sparse MoE clues concludes Jev is most plausibly a fine-tune of the open-source Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, noting that separating it from the successor Qwen3.6-35B-A3B would require behavioral probes.

原文标题：Jev 疑似基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 微调

Why it matters：揭示闭源 System One 模型的可能开源底座，对关注模型溯源与推理成本结构的读者有参考价值。

item.title: S&P Weighs Nvidia Downgrade Over Governance and Key Man Risk
item.description:
S&P Global Ratings is reviewing a potential one-notch cut to Nvidia's credit rating from AA to AA-, citing weak executive oversight, absent succession planning and heavy reliance on CEO Jensen Huang. The move would not cost Nvidia its investment-grade status but could raise borrowing costs for the company and the neoclouds and infrastructure firms it backstops.

item.title: OpenAI Researcher on Software Craft and Decision Models in the Agent Era
item.description:
Speaking at AI Engineer CODE, OpenAI researcher Thariq Shihipar argues that AI can make software cheap enough to ship by the thousand while still freeing time to perfect a single artifact. Drawing on a fighting-game /human folder for live tuning and a mode-switching Mac Dock, he explores where coding agents surprised him, how decision models pick among designer-defined actions, and who decides which experiments deserve compute.

item.title: OpenAI Preprints Claim Exact Matrix Multiplication Exponent of Nine Fourths
item.description:
OpenAI has posted preprints first establishing an upper bound of 9/4 for the matrix multiplication exponent omega, then a matching lower bound that would pin omega exactly at 9/4, a major moment for computational complexity. Parallel results on matching bounds for finite Fourier transforms suggest AI-assisted math output is outpacing human digestion.

原文标题：OpenAI 论文宣称矩阵乘法指数 ω 精确等于 9/4

Why it matters：若下界成立，矩阵乘法指数被精确锁定，属于理论计算机科学的里程碑级事件。

item.title: S&P Places Nvidia's AA Credit Rating on CreditWatch Negative
item.description:
S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia's AA credit rating on CreditWatch Negative, signaling a possible one-notch downgrade within 90 days. The agency also cut its management and governance assessment to neutral from positive, citing long director tenures that may compromise independence, weak executive oversight and the absence of a succession plan that leaves Nvidia dependent on Jensen Huang. A one-notch cut is expected unless investigations find export-rule circumvention or understated China exposure.

原文标题：标普将英伟达 AA 评级列入负面观察

Why it matters：这是评级机构对全球最重要 AI 算力公司治理与合规风险的一次正式警示，直接影响其融资成本与市场信心。

item.title: CBO and Anthropic AI Forecasts Diverge by $10 Trillion in GDP
item.description:
The Financial Times highlights a $10 trillion GDP gap between the US Congressional Budget Office, which credits AI with just 0.1-0.2 points of extra annual growth, and the extreme scenario in Anthropic's three-scenario model released in September 2026, which reaches 15%. That extreme case assumes AI surpasses humans on most knowledge tasks and performs nearly all of them autonomously, pushing knowledge-work unemployment to roughly 18%, while the UK's Office for Budget Responsibility sits near 0.2 points.

原文标题：美预算机构与 Anthropic 的 AI 增长预测相差 10 万亿美元

Why it matters：官方财政预测与前沿实验室情景假设之间出现 10 万亿美元量级分歧，直接关系 AI 经济影响的政策定价。

item.title: Google Patent for AI-Generated Personalized Video Feeds Sparks Concern
item.description:
Google's My Channel patent, filed last May and published last week, describes a system that uses demographic data, viewing history, IP addresses and GPS locations to auto-generate prompts for an LLM, producing personalized AI videos and ads. The patent has been rejected, though Google may appeal or resubmit an amended version. Critics argue the approach would further flood the internet with low-quality, unwanted content.

原文标题：谷歌申请 AI 定制视频流专利引发争议

Why it matters：该专利揭示了生成式 AI 在个性化内容分发上的激进应用路径，涉及数据隐私与内容生态质量，值得行业关注。

item.title: Anthropic Uses Claude to Generate 76,000-Line Lean 4 Riemann Hypothesis Proof
item.description:
Anthropic researchers released a Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the Riemann Hypothesis and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions, relying only on the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Produced in collaboration with Claude, it ships a ~300,000-line readable edition and a 76,000-line compact edition, but has passed machine checks only, with no mathematician review or accompanying paper.

原文标题：Anthropic 用 Claude 生成 7.6 万行 Lean 4 黎曼猜想证明

Why it matters：AI 参与形式化数学最核心难题之一，是检验大模型推理与定理证明能力的标志性事件。

item.title: Defang Breach Exposes Main Database and Deployment Credentials
item.description:
Cloud deployment platform Defang disclosed that an attacker breached its build system on November 12, stealing operational credentials and downloading a copy of its main database, confirmed only on November 23. Users who installed the Defang GitHub App may have had credentials usable against their repositories and cloud accounts; Defang has rotated them but requires users to perform their own checks.

原文标题：Defang 遭入侵 主数据库与部署凭证泄露

Why it matters：云部署平台供应链入侵事件，涉及 GitHub App 过度授权与云账户凭证外泄，对使用同类部署工具的团队有直接安全警示价值。

item.description:
Uber founder Travis Kalanick argued in an iConnections interview that AI will let new graduates act as bosses commanding the productivity of 50 people, predicting construction crews could shrink from 100 workers to three or four while skilled trades command star-level pay. He also framed automation as replacing users' own household labor rather than eliminating jobs, effectively returning time to individuals.

item.title: Anthropic Rebuilds Messages API in Rust Cutting CPU Use 70%
item.description:
Anthropic migrated its Messages API from Python to Rust, cutting per-request CPU usage by roughly 70% to absorb API traffic that has grown about 1,800x since early 2024. Claude produced a first draft in about a week, but the hard part was proving behavioral parity with the Python service, which teams of Claude agents used to track down and fix differences between the two versions.

原文标题：Anthropic 用 Rust 重写 Messages API 单请求 CPU 降 70%

Why it matters：这是大模型厂商核心推理服务栈的一次大规模语言级重写，并展示了用智能体做等价性验证的工程范式，对后端与 AI 基础设施读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: US Chip Curbs and Anti-Distillation Moves Are Already Slowing Chinese AI Labs
item.description:
According to The Information, US restrictions on Chinese firms' remote access to advanced Nvidia chips in overseas data centers, combined with successful anti-distillation measures by OpenAI and Anthropic, have delayed multiple projects at Chinese labs including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Alibaba since September 2025. DeepSeek researchers internally estimate the gap to top US models could widen from three to six months to nine months if the constraints persist.

原文标题：美国芯片管制与反蒸馏措施已拖慢中国 AI 实验室

Why it matters：这是算力管制与模型蒸馏攻防首次被具体量化为中国头部实验室的进度损失，对判断中美 AI 竞争节奏具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Artificial Analysis Launches FrontierPhysics Leaderboard for Physics Research Agents
item.description:

Claude Fable 5.2 leads at 32%, six points ahead of GPT-6.2 Astra, with the top six models clustered between 22% and 32%, underscoring how far agents remain from reliable physics research.

原文标题：Artificial Analysis 发布 FrontierPhysics 物理研究智能体榜单

Why it matters：首个面向真实物理科研流程的私有防污染智能体评测榜单，揭示了前沿模型在科研任务上的真实短板。

item.title: Ubuntu Lags Nine Days on Critical Kernel CVE Fixes
item.description:
Security researcher Hanno Böck flagged on the oss-security mailing list that Ubuntu has yet to ship fixes for a remote memory corruption flaw in the Linux kernel TCP stack (NoisyTCP, CVE-2026-99288) and an AMD KVM host escape (CVE-2026-99312), nine days after the former was disclosed, while other distributions had patches ready at publication. The gap highlights latency in a major distribution's security response process and poses direct risk to Ubuntu-based server and cloud operators.

原文标题：Ubuntu 修复高危内核漏洞滞后九天

Why it matters：主流发行版对高危内核漏洞的修复时延直接影响生产环境安全，值得运维与安全读者关注。

item.title: Linux Kernel NFS Server Exposes Pre-Auth Remote Root Flaw Scoring 9.8
item.description:
A pre-auth heap overflow tracked as CVE-2026-99362 has lurked in the Linux kernel's nfsd for 12 years, letting an unauthenticated attacker write 61 bytes past a kernel heap object over a single TCP connection and chain it into a root shell. Any host serving NFSv4.1/4.2 on reachable tcp/2049 is exposed; the flaw is fixed in Linux 6.12.117, 6.18.61, 7.3.2 and 7.4-rc1, so operators should patch and reboot or firewall port 2049 immediately.

原文标题：Linux 内核 NFS 服务器曝 9.8 分预认证远程 root 漏洞

Why it matters：一个潜伏 12 年、CVSS 9.8 的预认证远程 root 漏洞直接威胁海量文件服务器与 K8s 存储节点，修复窗口紧迫且影响面极广。

item.title: Artificial Analysis Launches Robotics Sim Benchmark for Humanoid Control
item.description:
Artificial Analysis released AA-Robotics-Sim v0.1, a research preview in which frontier language models directly control a simulated Unitree G1 humanoid through native harnesses across 10 tasks spanning embodied reasoning, pick-and-place, assembly, tool use and mobility. Each model first runs five practice episodes, then is evaluated on ten varied new scenes. GPT-6.2 Astra leads at 71.0, ahead of Claude Fable 5.2 (57.5) and GPT-6.2 Sol (53.7), while some skills look mature but long-horizon task completion remains weak, with each episode costing $0.84 to $9.01 and taking 17 to 39 minutes.

原文标题：Artificial Analysis 发布机器人仿真基准 前沿模型操控人形机器人

Why it matters：首个由第三方评测机构推出的 LLM 直接驱动机器人的仿真基准，为具身智能能力对比提供了可复现的量化标尺。

OpenAI has begun rolling out a unified Chat and Work experience in ChatGPT to a small group of Pro subscribers, simplifying navigation between conversations and complex tasks. The company acknowledged that a small fraction of its heaviest users may hit usage limits sooner, prompting subscriber concerns over merged quotas.

Why it matters：涉及 ChatGPT 核心产品形态调整与用量策略变化，直接影响重度用户的日常使用决策。

item.title: Abstract Launches Cloud Inference for Robots with 30ms Round Trip
item.description:
Abstract has launched a cloud inference service that moves robot model compute off the device and onto its own GPUs. Robots send camera frames, current state and a plain-language task, and the service returns the next chunk of motion commands with a claimed 30ms round trip. The model turns GPU hardware from a per-unit purchase into a per-request bill, shifting the cost math for teams building robots at scale.

原文标题：Abstract 推出机器人云端推理 30 毫秒往返

Why it matters：机器人推理从板载 GPU 转向云端按请求计费，是具身智能成本结构的一次实质性变化。

item.title: NTU 新方法让智能体学会等待 准确率提升 17.1%
item.description:
新加坡南洋理工大学提出 RLVB（可验证信念强化学习）方法，针对智能体在自身笔记仍列出多个候选答案时却过早锁定单一答案的问题，改为奖励“证据不足时继续探索、证据充分时再作答”的决策过程，而非仅奖励最终答案。在 3 个 Qwen 视觉语言模型与 3 个基准上平均超越基座模型 17.1%，而传统结果奖励强化学习反而低于基座。训练后，模型在证据不足却强行作答的比例从 3% 至 68% 降至 0.1% 至 2.2%。

Why it matters：直击智能体“过早下结论”的普遍失效模式，用可验证信念重塑奖励信号，并给出跨模型跨基准的量化提升。
